test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

We are planning to go to Delhi ______ train.
solution:
The correct answer is **'by'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The preposition **'by'** is used to describe **how** we are traveling somewhere.
 
• Example- He went by **car.**
 
• So the most appropriate option is **'by'** to fill in the blank.
